Survivable. Connected. About F-35 The Centerpiece of 21st Century Global Security The F-35 strengthens national security, enhances global partnerships and powers economic growth. As the most lethal, survivable and connected fighter jet in the world, the F-35 gives pilots the critical advantage against any adversary, enabling them to execute their mission and come home safe. WATCH: The F-35s Unrivaled Capabilities The F-35 delivers an unrivaled advantage for our pilots, nation and global partners as the most advanced node in the networked 21st Century Security vision. Strengthening global security, enhancing partnerships and powering economic growth Delivers an unrivaled advantage for our pilots, nation, and global partners Unites allies and strengthens global security Delivers 5th Generation sustainment for mission readiness Strengthens communities worldwide We are delivering transformational capabilities for 21st Century Security. Enabling Joint All Domain Operations Evolving for Tomorrow’s Threats Enabling global customers to stay ahead of ready far into the future. F-35 EOTS The Electro-Optical Targeting System (EOTS) for the F-35 Lightning II is an affordable, high-performance, lightweight, multi-function system that provides precision air-to-air and air-to-surface targeting capability.
